name: Astronomy Sensor
description: Outputs relative position data based on the optimal target trajectory between the earth and moon.
shortDescription: A sensor that provides raw space navigation data.

logicNodes.label: Data
logicNodes.description: Outputs [1] x position in metres, [2] y position in metres (earth sea level is 0), [3] z position in metres, [4] euler rotation x, [5] euler rotation y, [6] euler rotation z, [7] angular velocity x, [8] angular velocity y, [9] angular velocity z, [10] local z tilt and [11] local x tilt to the respective composite channels.
